name: Gerze Tunnel
facts: Gerze Tunnel stretches 348 meters per tube, forming a twin‑tube, two‑lane passage that opened to traffic on 26 March 2014.
Built by Turkish Cengiz Construction Company, Gerze Tunnel sits on the Sinop‑Samsun Highway D.010, a key stretch of the Black Sea Coastal Highway.
The tunnel is bookended by the 1,680‑meter Demirciköy Tunnel to the northwest and the 1,598‑meter Yenikent Tunnel to the southeast, creating a continuous high‑speed corridor.
